events.evidence: An estimated 800,000 federal government workers miss their first paycheck of the shutdown as it enters into its 21st day, which ties the record set by the shutdown of 1995 and 1996
Juan Guaidó holds an open cabildo, performed as a rally and national address, announcing his plans to take control of the Presidency of Venezuela
Two Iraqis were killed and 25 others were injured in a car bomb blast outside a public market in the town of Al-Qaim

label.note: US shutdown hits record length, Venezuela leadership crisis, Iraq attack; risk-off.
